findings.evidence: import com.pte.overview.internal.dto.response.DashboardSection;  -- never referenced in the class body (only DashboardSectionRunner returns it).
findings.why_it_matters: Unused import is dead code in a new file.

findings.evidence: learners() calls enrollment.academicCounts(tenantId) only to read assignedLearners(); academics() calls enrollment.academicCounts(tenantId) again. academicCounts() runs 3 count queries (programs, classes, memberships), so programs+classes counts run twice per request and are discarded in learners().
findings.why_it_matters: Redundant uncached queries on every dashboard refetch (core counts are intentionally not cached); not a correctness issue.
findings.required_action: Optional: expose a dedicated assigned-learners count on the enrollment facade (or share one academicCounts result across both sections) so each query runs once.

findings.evidence: @QueryHints(@QueryHint(name = "jakarta.persistence.query.timeout", value = "2000")) is repeated on two queries; DashboardCacheKeys uses the inline literal "host" while every other key part is a named constant.
findings.why_it_matters: A meaningful timeout and a key segment live as unnamed literals; tuning/renaming needs a multi-site edit.
findings.required_action: Optional: hoist the 2000 ms hint into a (compile-time) constant in attempt's constants and the "host" segment into OverviewConstants.

findings.evidence: void all_sixteen_business_modules_plus_shared_are_detected() ... "16 business modules" comment, while the asserted list now holds 18 business modules (examstaff and overview added) plus shared.
findings.why_it_matters: Method name/comment now contradict the assertion; the assertion itself is correct and not loosened (containsExactlyInAnyOrder retained).
findings.required_action: Optional: reword the method name/comment so they do not hard-code a count.

findings.evidence: spring.data.redis has only host/port (no timeout / connect-timeout). DashboardCache catches RuntimeException (fast failures degrade correctly), but a blackholed Redis would block redisTemplate.opsForValue().get(key) for the client default command timeout.
findings.why_it_matters: 'Cache failure never fails the request' holds for errors, but a hung Redis could stall the host dashboard. Same global config already applies to PinnedSnapshotCacheService and RateLimitConfig, so this is pre-existing, project-wide exposure rather than something this phase introduced.
findings.required_action: Track separately: set spring.data.redis.timeout / connect-timeout project-wide.

findings.evidence: for (int i = 0; i < boundaries.size() - 1; i++) { counts.add(attemptRepository.countSubmittedBetween(tenantId, boundaries.get(i), boundaries.get(i + 1))); }
findings.why_it_matters: 12 sequential indexed counts on a cache miss (each with a 2s hint). Accepted by the phase (portable JPQL, H2-runnable, series cached 30s, one indexed count per range); a single grouped query would be a later optimisation, not a defect.
findings.required_action: None required; revisit only if the EXPLAIN/latency capture shows the miss path is slow.

findings.evidence: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attempts_tenant_submitted ON exam_attempts (tenant_id, submitted_at) WHERE deleted = false;  (six indexes, none CONCURRENTLY)
findings.why_it_matters: Migration is idempotent, indexes-only, additive (old and new app versions both safe), rollback documented in the header, same shape as V93. Plain CREATE INDEX briefly blocks writes on exam_attempts/users/exam_sessions during Flyway's transactional run; negligible at current scale. Column/table names verified against V9__attempt.sql.
findings.required_action: None; note for a production-scale rollout. The Postgres-gated migration test and the EXPLAIN captures were NOT run (per phase testing state).

findings.evidence: CurrentUser caller = CurrentUserContext.required(); if (caller.tenantId() == null) { throw new AccessDeniedException(SharedConstants.ACCESS_DENIED); }
findings.why_it_matters: The null-tenant guard sits in the controller and HostDashboardService.build(UUID,...) does not re-check. Not exploitable: @PreAuthorize gates HOST_ADMIN, a null tenant matches no rows, and tenancy.getStudentQuota(null) throws; controller test covers HOST_ADMIN with a null tenant -> 403. Siblings (StudentWorkspaceQueryService:131) put the same guard in the service, and the controller inlines CurrentUserContext.required() instead of the private currentUser() helper.
findings.required_action: None; consider moving the guard into the service if a second caller of build() appears.

findings.evidence: public static <T> DashboardSection<T> forbidden() { ... SectionStatus.FORBIDDEN ... } has no production caller in Phase 1.
findings.why_it_matters: Forward-declared for the role-gated admin sections of later phases (the phase's envelope definition explicitly lists ok/error/forbidden); acceptable, flagged only so it is not forgotten.
findings.required_action: None; verify it is used by Phase 3 or remove.

verification_notes.module_boundaries: overview imports only shared, tenancy (TenancyService, StudentQuota), and the four new root facades/records; no .internal/.domain imports of other modules. package-info declares allowedDependencies {shared, tenancy, identity, enrollment, session, attempt}. No module imports com.pte.overview (leaf). New facades only use their own module's repositories/enums, so enrollment gains no new allowed dependency and attempt/session/enrollment cycle gains no edge. Facade return types are primitives, root records, String-keyed maps and Strings (no identity::domain/session::domain enum leakage).
verification_notes.architecture_violation_set: tests/arch/baseline-arch-violations.txt and tests/arch/after-arch-p1-violations.txt are line-for-line identical (18 lines: 7 cycles + 11 'Allowed targets'); the grep count of 'Allowed targets' and 'Cycle detected' matches in the raw tests/arch/baseline-arch.txt vs tests/arch/after-arch-p1.txt (22 / 14 each) and 'overview' occurs 0 times in tests/arch/after-arch-p1.txt. ModuleStructureTest module-list assertion keeps containsExactlyInAnyOrder and only adds examstaff and overview. Verified from stored artifacts; tests were not re-run by this reviewer (read-only, no shell tools available).
verification_notes.tenant_isolation: Tenant id originates only from CurrentUserContext (token); the controller has no tenant parameter (test controllerAcceptsNoTenantParameter). Every new query filters tenant (u.tenantId, s.tenantId, a.tenantId, m.tenantId, o.tenant.publicId, organization tenant publicId) and soft-delete (deleted = false on users, sessions, attempts, programs, classes, memberships, enrollments, organizations). The only non-tenant-filtered query, EnrollmentRepository.countGroupedBySessionIds, is fed only ids from the tenant-scoped findUpcoming and is module-internal. Cache key = dash:host:v1:<tenantId>:<windowDays>:<series>; null tenant rejected.
verification_notes.security: @PreAuthorize(hasRole('HOST_ADMIN')) at class level, null tenant -> AccessDeniedException -> 403 via GlobalExceptionHandler; no raw error text in responses (DashboardSectionRunner logs with correlationId, returns ERROR section); windowDays read as String so non-numeric yields InvalidDashboardWindowException 400 with stable code.
verification_notes.correctness: DashboardWindow: current [now-N, now), previous [now-2N, now-N), half-open, contiguous. TrendCalculator: previous == 0 -> null pct, otherwise BigDecimal (cur-prev)*100/prev scale 1 HALF_UP (negative changes handled). MonthBuckets: 12 calendar-month boundaries in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, last bucket (month of now) flagged partial, upper boundary = first of next month; labels derived from the same YearMonth so counts and labels align.
verification_notes.cache: Only the 12-month series is cached (TTL 30s, schema-versioned key); core counts are uncached. Read and write failures are caught (RuntimeException incl. Jackson), logged without payload, and degrade to direct computation; loader exceptions propagate to the per-section runner.
verification_notes.size_and_naming: All new files well under 300 lines (largest HostDashboardService 135). Constructor DI, @Transactional(readOnly = true) facades, views as root records, DomainException subclass with code in per-module constants, controller shape (@RestController, @RequestMapping, ApiResponse.success) all match siblings.
verification_notes.tests_coverage_skimmed: Tests exist for window parsing, trend math, month buckets (+ boundary data), section runner isolation, cache keys, cache fallback, service composition, controller (200/403/400, null-tenant, tenant-param absence, Redis down), and repository query tests for identity, enrollment, session, attempt. Not run by this reviewer; Postgres migration test and EXPLAIN capture are documented in the phase as NOT RUN.
